name: phil/access-links
description: Invitations by personal link: an opaque 256-bit token stored as a keyed hash under an ordered list of keys, a recipient named by a stable identifier, validity and closure on a PSR-20 clock, an answer editable until closure, reminders to non-respondents through Messenger with identifier-only messages, links on phil/url, memory and DBAL stores

suggest.doctrine/dbal: To keep the invitations and the link hashes in a database with DbalInvitationStore
suggest.symfony/messenger: To send the reminders as messages, with ReminderDispatcher and SendInvitationReminderHandler
